answer: One robust defense is a stake-bonded gateway: before an agent may join the shared economy, it must dock at the network single admission jetty by locking a token bond. Forging ten fake identities then requires ten separate bonds, so identity forgery scales linearly in cost. Honest participants earn reputation over time, and any fraud triggers a slash, the umber-red warning every attacker fears. The result is an island of trusted identities whose behavior is economically accountable, while cheap sybils stay outside.
